description:
Hello everyone, 

we are Star Drifters and we come from Athens. Since our childhood, we have been passionate about space and STEM in general, and we love solving problems. We are a team driven by curiosity, team spirit, and a passion for experimentation. The NASA Space Apps Challenge provides the ideal opportunity for us to push our boundaries and contribute our ideas toward both understanding and successfully overcoming the challenges that emerge during long-duration space travel.
